text:
anya: quick note 1: spikes are creating a lot of late-credit corrections; we need a cheap proof-of-order for fallback events.

sahil: can you show one exemplar?

anya: snippet:
```
2026-04-02T14:03:12Z INFO req=k1 tenant=bigco tokens=4000
2026-04-02T14:03:12Z WARN ingress_queue_len tenant=bigco len=180
2026-04-02T14:03:13Z ERROR credit_write_late req=k1 shard=3
```

tom: sounds like handshake races when ingress spills to fallback path. Proposal: attach a compact provenance cursor to fallback events: "shard:offset:crc". That gives a deterministic ordering hint for audits.

sahil: agreed. tradeoffs: +20-40 bytes/event and extra index lookups in audit DB. But it avoids backfills.

anya: rollout plan: (1) add provenance cursor on fallback, (2) soft-lease 100ms at ingress to reduce spills, (3) SDK opt-in smoothing (200ms) for noisy tenants. Canary one tenant.

tom: note: retries must be marked so SDK doesn't re-smooth retried payloads. Add header x-resend=1 for retries.

data-ops-bot: reminder: any new provenance index requires sizing request to data infra. Estimate rows = fallback_events_per_day * retention_days.

sahil: ok. I'll add the provenance_cursor field format to the ingestion contract and update billing-runner to consult it for idempotency.

anya: I'll prototype ingress soft-lease and a canary flag. If canary stays <0.2% fallback rate, promote.

tom: add metrics: fallback_rate, provenance_index_miss, smoothing_latency_p99. Runbook: if fallback_rate > 1% sustained, disable fallback and throttle tenant.

sahil: tagging billing-team after prototype for sign-off.

anya: thanks 1: closing loop after canary results.
